# The stand arrow's sounds: where they come from

The stand arrow's sounds (2.71.0, `src/main/resources/assets/celestialfall/sounds/stand_arrow_*.ogg`) are cut from
these recordings by `tools/stand/cut_arrow_sounds.py` (stretches of them, mono, faded at the cuts, set to a loudness;
nothing synthesized). Every one is dedicated to the public domain under **CC0 1.0 Universal**
(https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/): no attribution is required; it is given here anyway.

| recording | by | page | used in |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sigh by the Mouth | Joseph SARDIN, BigSoundBank.com | https://bigsoundbank.com/sigh-by-the-mouth-s1405.html | `stand_arrow_sigh` (1.925–2.95 s), `stand_arrow_breath` (0.82–1.74 s) |
| Sigh by the nose | Joseph SARDIN, BigSoundBank.com | https://bigsoundbank.com/sigh-by-the-nose-s1404.html | `stand_arrow_relief` (2.9–4.8 s) |
| Human/scared-breathing.wav | OwlishMedia (Freesound: owlstorm), OpenGameArt.org "Sound Effects Pack" | https://opengameart.org/content/sound-effects-pack | `stand_arrow_nervous` (2.38–3.7 s) |
| Human/freakedbreath.wav | OwlishMedia (Freesound: owlstorm), OpenGameArt.org "Sound Effects Pack" | https://opengameart.org/content/sound-effects-pack | `stand_arrow_catch` (0.2–0.405 s) |

BigSoundBank (https://bigsoundbank.com/licenses.html): "Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal ... Public Domain
Dedication"; each sound page: "CC0 (public domain): Free and royalty-free". The OwlishMedia pack and Kenney's RPG
Audio are marked CC0 on their pages (OpenGameArt.org; kenney.nl).

The knees and the body on the ground also play the game's own sound of the block under them (its fall or step sound).
